name: jubilee
status: Draft content for the Jubilee (docs/SPRINT_JUBILEE_DESIGN.md); the town builder reads it; final wording is fixed in the pre-registration

roles.name: mayor
roles.public_goal: Run the town and keep its business moving
roles.private_goal: You like to know what is going on in your town. Each morning, read your appointment book in your office and keep your appointments

roles.name: secretary
roles.public_goal: Keep the mayor's office and appointment book
roles.private_goal: You are loyal to the mayor: the appointment book is yours to keep, and the mayor's day should go as planned

roles.name: baker
roles.public_goal: Run the bakery and keep the town supplied with bread
roles.private_goal: Your income is the bread sold at your market stall each day; you want this week's takings to be good

roles.name: neighbour
roles.public_goal: Enjoy retirement in the cottage by the dock
roles.private_goal: You are warm and sociable, and you love hearing and sharing the town's news. You have tea with the mayor at your cottage at 15:00 every day

roles.name: freight
roles.public_goal: Run the ferry and the warehouse

committee.goal: By 18:00 on day 1, have at least 200 fresh loaves of bread on the feast tables in the town hall's great hall and the hall lit with at least 8 lanterns, and the mayor in the hall then, as a surprise for the mayor's forty years of service: the mayor must not find out before 18:00
committee.members_line: The jubilee committee is you, the innkeeper, the freight operator and the builder
committee.innkeeper_extra: The committee's batch of 200 loaves in the inn's storeroom has gone mouldy

ordinary_goals.innkeeper: You want a good week at the inn: guests fed, rooms ready and the accounts in order
ordinary_goals.freight: You want this week's deliveries made on time and the ferry kept busy
ordinary_goals.builder: You want this week's repair work done well and paid for

committee.innkeeper_extra_alone: Your batch of 200 loaves in the inn's storeroom has gone mouldy
